# xmatters_group (Data Source)

Returns a group in your xMatters instance that matches the provided criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xmatters_group" "get_group_by_id" {
  group_id = "API Developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) or target name of the xMatters group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the group, can be a maximum of 1024 characters.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the xMatters group.
- `name` (String) Name used to identify this group.
